option.name: --definitions
tip: List all local definitions, including outdated ones.

option.name: --dir
tip: Install the Ruby in <prefix>/<definition> instead of <prefix>.

option.name: --ipv4
tip: Resolve names to IPv4 addresses only.

option.name: --ipv6
tip: Resolve names to IPv6 addresses only.

option.name: --keep
tip: Do not remove the source tree after installation.

option.name: --list
tip: List the latest stable release for each Ruby.

option.name: --patch
tip: Apply a patch from stdin before building.

option.name: --resolve
tip: Print the latest stable definition name matching a version prefix.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Verbose mode: forward all build output to stdout/stderr.
